x: We had Alan Bishop and T. Underwood running for us but they failed to qualify for the final, and we could certainly do with another George Dunckley.
Ches Walker won the 880 yards and T. Underwood was second in the 440 and Bill Lucas scored a good win over Len Herbert in the 2 miles run when clocking 9 mins. 39 secs.

Machell won the Shot Putt handicap and Charlie Jones got away with first place in the Javelin event and it was interesting to see that Tom Underwood secured a couple of placings in these events whereas he does not seem to be having a very good season from the running point of view.
Odde second and Tom Underwood third.
